title: India's Kerala Approves 100 MW Kasaragod Solar Park with Battery Energy Storage
detail: Kerala's state government approved a 100 MW solar park in Kasaragod district to include a battery energy storage system (BESS), marking a significant step in India's grid-scale storage deployment. The project advances renewable integration at the state level and reflects growing momentum for co-located solar-plus-storage infrastructure in South Asia.
